rules.accepted_credit_types: Board and staff do not pre-approve CE courses; categories per A.A.C. R4-26-207
rules.new_licensee_rule: First license cycle: CE requirements prorated; see the issuance letter for individual CE and expiration date.
rules.notes: Renew by last day of birth month every other year (odd/even year per odd/even license number). New 4 h Jurisprudence Education Tool (JET) category; 4 h ethics remains; total stays 40 h. CE recorded in CE Broker before renewal. Other category limits in R4-26-207 not verified.
